'''Bespin cloud meringue cake''' was a traditional [[Cake/Legends|cake]] [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] that could be enjoyed with [[Caf/Legends|caf]]. It shared its name with<ref name="Ascension" /> the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]&ndash;type [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> Human [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Fost Bramsin]] enjoyed the cake along with caf at the [[Drikl Lecersen's estate|estate]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Ascension" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bespin cloud meringue cake was mentioned in the novel [[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension|''Ascension'']], written by [[Christie Golden]] and published in [[2011]] as the ninth installment of the ''[[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi]]'' series.<ref name="Ascension" />
